script.title: Grounding Helps AI Answers but Is Not a Guarantee
script.description: A source-grounded explanation of why connecting AI to documents still requires verification and evaluation.

scenes.narration: Giving an AI system sources can improve factuality, but it does not turn every answer into a verified fact.
Grounding connects generated answers to outside information; the system still has to represent that information accurately.

diagram.title: Grounding workflow
diagram.note: Grounding supports factuality; verification still matters.

scenes.narration: NIST identifies confidently false content as a generative AI risk, including answers whose references or details are inaccurate.
A useful review therefore compares the actual claim with its supporting source, rather than judging only how professional it sounds.
Application evaluation also matters because a system may behave differently across tasks, inputs, and the sources available to it.
Grounding is a useful safeguard, not a promise of perfection; supported claims and unsupported claims must still be distinguished.

diagram.title: Support is not certainty
diagram.note: Evaluate the output, not only the presence of a citation.

sources.title: Reviewed primary-source evidence
sources.content: NIST AI 600-1, July 2024, identifies confabulation: generative AI can confidently present erroneous or false content. Outputs can contain inaccurate information or false citations. Confident language is not proof of accuracy. Evaluation and verification of generated content are part of managing the risk; no model output should be treated as inherently verified.

sources.title: Reviewed primary-source evidence
sources.content: Generative AI can produce inaccurate or unexpected outputs. Post-processing and rigorous manual evaluation are important. Grounding with Google Search can improve factuality by connecting output to source information; it does not establish that every output is correct. Developers must evaluate applications rather than assume all generated output is reliable.
